textbookBox.concept: This old poem gives a simple rule: when you work, give your whole attention to the work, and when you play, play fully. Doing one thing at a time and doing it well is the way to be useful and happy.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 english · One Thing at a Time · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: The poem says: work while you work and play while you play. To be useful and happy, we should do everything with all our might, which means with all our strength and effort.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: The poem says: work while you work and play while you play. To be useful and happy, we should do everything with all our might, which means with all our strength and effort.
beats.speakEn: The poem says: work while you work and play while you play. To be useful and happy, we should do everything with all our might, which means with all our strength and effort.

beats.en: When you do one thing at a time, you finish faster and make fewer mistakes. Focus helps you learn better. If you try to do many things together, you may do all of them badly.
beats.speakEn: When you do one thing at a time, you finish faster and make fewer mistakes. Focus helps you learn better. If you try to do many things together, you may do all of them badly.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 english · One Thing at a Time · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Might means strength or power. Useful means helpful or beneficial. Moments are short periods of time. Use them in sentences: She pushed the door with all her might. A pencil is useful for writing.

beats.en: Might means strength or power. Useful means helpful or beneficial. Moments are short periods of time. Use them in sentences: She pushed the door with all her might. A pencil is useful for writing.
beats.speakEn: Might means strength or power. Useful means helpful or beneficial. Moments are short periods of time. Use them in sentences: She pushed the door with all her might. A pencil is useful for writing.

beats.en: To say what is happening now we use is or are with an action word ending in -ing. Two girls are going to school. A woman is typing on a computer. A boy is reading a book. Use is for one person and are for more than one.

textbookBox.concept: Some words have a letter that we write but do not say. In calm, palm, chalk, talk, calf and balm the l is silent. In leaf, jail, hall, clean, shelf, silk, plum and self we do hear the l.
